text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync thread for the upcoming benchmark blog — soft launch on Thu Jul 9 at 15:00 UTC. Need final PR & Legal signoff by Wed EOD. Main asks: embargo list, CEO quote, sanitized dashboard screenshots, and a short API starter snippet. Doc: https://docs.google.com/bench-launch-kit

Evan (PR): Noted. I'll prepare embargo emails for top-tier + select trades. Do we want a separate embargo for partners?

Maya (Marketing): Single embargo window. Partners can syndicate after 15:00 UTC. We'll include localized one-liners for APAC/EU.

Sofia (Design): Uploading hero + two GIF variants. Reminder: avoid raw dashboard screenshots — I'll prepare anonymized charts.

Ravi (Legal): Added methodology blurb and a short disclaimer about test conditions. Also: please avoid absolute performance claims in social copy.

Zoe (Platform): Publish plan queued. Job ID 91234. Pre-publish checks at T-30m. I'll enable a temporary traffic mirror to staging for 1h post-publish.

OpsBot: publish_job scheduled id=91234 -> 2026-07-09T15:00:00Z; alerts at T-60m,T-30m,T-5m. Rollback flag: infra.publish_disable.

Evan (PR): Draft embargo email in the doc. I'll send to 8 reporters Thu EOD. Also prepping a short embargo Q&A for top-tier.

Maya (Marketing): Add API snippet: curl example + expected output. Sofia, attach the GIF that demos latency visually.

Sofia (Design): Done. Filenames: hero_0707_v2.png, demo_gif_short.gif. Both in the shared assets folder.

Zoe (Platform): Smoke test pass on staging. Rate limits set to mirror published bench. I'll be on-call T+3h.

Ravi (Legal): Signed off. Marking the sheet.

Maya (Marketing): Final checklist: PR 2705, Legal 2705, Assets 2705, Ops 2705. If embargo breaks, follow the embargo incident playbook and pause all distributions. Link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/embargo-playbook

Evan (PR): Roger that. I'll join the T-15m call.

Zoe (Platform): Reminder set for T-30m in #marketing and #eng-oncall.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — see you at T-30m. :rocket:
